 HUMBOLDT TRAIL BRIDGE REPLACEMENT  
Pacific Coast (PCT)  

  Forest: Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest (HTNF) 
Bridgeport Ranger Station  

 The purpose of this project is to replace the Pacific Crest Trail (PCT) trail bridge over the West Fork West Walker River. The bridge is located in a remote location of the Hoover Wilderness, where there is no motorized access.  

 Due to the remoteness of the location, Site Visit will be conducted by Zoom. Offerors are permitted to visit the site at their convenience.
